Heathcliff, The Heartbroken
<width=90%>心被撕碎的希斯克利夫

dataList.content:
I see Distorted Heathcliff before me.
扭曲了的希斯克利夫就在我的面前。

He mauls, rips, and tears into everything before him...
虽然他张牙舞爪地摧毁着眼前的一切……

... but his mournful howling is tinged with so much pain that it hurts me to even listen.
但他那嚎叫声，却满含令人不忍耳闻的痛苦与悲伤。

He's killing everyone... the researchers, the Dead Rabbits, even people trapped in the glass pods...
实验管里的人、研究员、死兔帮，每个人都被毫不留情地杀死了……

<If we were to get in his way...>
<如果我们挡在希斯克利夫面前的话……>

Yes, Executive Manager. He will not hesitate to attack us as well.
是的，他会毫不犹豫地向我们发起攻击。经理。

This will be a difficult battle for everyone.
这对所有人来说都必定会是一场艰难的战斗。

And it will leave nothing but deep gashes in our hearts.
并且所有人都会受到严重的伤害。

<We have to bring him back.>
<我们也必须让他恢复原状。>

The clock turns.
时钟转动。
